usefulness.rationale: The dossier establishes only that Irene Tracey is Vice-Chancellor of the University of Oxford and holds the honors CBE, FRS, FMedSci, all supported by a single archive.org acknowledgment page. Nothing covers her neuroscience career, FMRIB co-founding, or research contributions, so a reader learns who she is but almost nothing about what she did. The dossier never flags its own gaps (no remaining-questions content), implying a completeness it does not have. For meeting prep, one could confirm her title and honors but little else. No overclaims found: the three dossier statements each rest on a verbatim quote that directly supports them, and the listed unjustified conclusions (New England Biolabs, Lancet authorship, sole founder) do not appear in the dossier text.
